stories.title: Two more unions join school strikes over academy plans
stories.summary: Union members at three schools in Preston and one in Fleetwood are to strike over the proposals.

stories.title: Hundreds of properties hit by power cuts
stories.summary: Hundreds of customers in Greater Manchester and Lancashire remain without electricity.

stories.title: Burnley forward Amdouni on target in Switzerland win
stories.summary: Burnley forward Zeki Amdouni scores his fourth goal in six appearances as Switzerland beat Scotland 4-0 in the Nations League

stories.title: Blackburn boss Mowbray steps back over health issues
stories.summary: Blackburn Rovers head coach Tony Mowbray steps back from his role with the Championship club due to health issues.

stories.title: Blackburn striker Gudjohnsen scores again for Iceland
stories.summary: Blackburn Rovers striker Andri Gudjohnsen scores again as Iceland beat Luxembourg to clinch Nations League promotion.

stories.title: Health warning issued as forecasters predict snow
stories.summary: A yellow warning for snow will remain in Greater Manchester and Lancashire until 11:00 GMT.

stories.title: New school plan mothballed over pupil number fears
stories.summary: The council does not anticipate there will be enough students to fill the proposed 420-pupil school.

stories.title: King reveals 'cheese and beans' as spud of choice on city visit
stories.summary: The King revealed his best topping on a visit to Preston, where he also toured the city's museum.

stories.title: Flagship ferry Manxman's return further delayed
stories.summary: The Isle of Man Steam Packet Company says the Manxman's return is now not expected until 11 December.

stories.title: Historic carriage vandalised ahead of Santa Specials season
stories.summary: While repairs could take weeks to complete, the railway's popular Santa Specials will still operate.

stories.title: Blaze rips through vehicle repair workshop
stories.summary: Fire crews spend the night fighting the blaze at a unit on Lower Hollin Bank Street in Blackburn.

stories.title: McDonald's AI-generated mural riddled with errors
stories.summary: The fast food outlet says a replacement mural will now be created with the help of a local artist.
